title: Move ownership into and out of a function
summary: Distinguish copied integers, a moved String and a returned owner. Make a deep copy only when two independently mutable strings are required.

parameter.clue: Owned UTF-8 text parameter type transferred into decorate

returned.clue: Owned UTF-8 text return type transferred back out of decorate

suffix.clue: Method appending the string slice "!" to an owned string

integer.clue: Unsigned 32-bit integer type; assignment copies its value

duplicate.clue: Method making an independent owned duplicate of original before it is moved

construct.clue: Associated conversion function constructing owned UTF-8 text using a string literal

check.clue: Macro checking that moved equals the expected decorated text

bytes.clue: Method counting UTF-8 bytes in moved
